chapter.verse: Uliante leh ukna thuneite' kiangah mite a niamlut nading leh amaute a thumang, nahoih sepna namkim' ading a kigingkhol ahih nadingun phawkkiksak in.
Amaute in kuamah gendai lo-in kitotna peel ding uh a, thudikin mi khempeuh' tungah thunemna lak ding uh hi.

A hang pen eite zong nidangin a haitat, a thumanglo, a lamkhial, cilesa lunggulhna leh cilesa nopsakna tuamtuamte ah sila a suak i hi a, khatlekhat kimudah kihua-in thusia leh hazatna tawh i hunte i beisak hi.
Himah taleh eite' Honpa i Pasian, a migitna leh mihing hong itna hong kilat ciangin
amah in eite hong honkhia a, tua pen eite' dik gamtatna hang hilo-in ama' thukhualna tunga kinga, pianthakna tawh kipawl siansuahna hang leh Kha Siangtho' hong thaksuaksakna hang ahi hi.
Amah in Jesu Khris i Honpa' tungtawnin eite' tungah Kha Siangtho kicingtak hong pia hi.
Tua pen ama' hehpihna hangin diksakna a ngah ahi eite, tawntung nuntakna tawh kipawl lametna dung zui-in gamhluahte i suah theih nading ahi hi.
Hih thugenna a muantaak thu hi a, nahoih sepna ah mapan ding vai Pasian a um mite in a thupilak nadingun hih thute na gen teitei ding kong deih hi.
Ahi zongin taanglam lo takin thu a maanzaw kituhna, khanggui sutna, kikhenkakna, thukhun vai kinialna, cihte phattuamna om lo-in a mawknapi ahih manin tuate peel in.
Kikhenkakna a pholhsuah mipa tawh kisai-in khatvei nihvei na taaibawl khit ciangin amah tawh kipaikan nawnkei in.
Tua bang mihing pen a khel a vet, amahmah mawhna kipholaktawm ahi hi.
Artemas, ahihkeileh Tychicus, kong paisak ciangin Nicopolis khua kei' kiangah hihtheihtawp hanciamin hong pai in. A hang pen tua takah phalbi hun zat ding ka khensat khin hi.
Thukhun hilhcian sya Zenas, leh Apollos, a khualzin vai uh hihtheihtawp na van in; kisap bangmah na neisak kei in.
Hih pen i mite kimanna neilo ahilo, thuphamawh a tuakte a huh thei ahih nadingun amau zong nahoih sepna thupilak ding ahihlam a theikha uh hi pah hen.
Kei' kianga om teng in a vekun nang hopih uh hi. Upna hangin ei hong it mite na hopihsak in. Note khempeuh' tungah hehpihna hong om ta hen.
